depot.description: Single depot, used as both start and end for every vehicle.

time_limit_s.description: Solve budget in seconds; omit to auto-scale with problem size.

OptimizeDepot.description: The single depot: a place plus depot constraints (open window, handling).

OptimizeStop.description: A delivery/pickup stop: a place plus solver site constraints.

force_allow_sites.description: Stop ids ONLY this-typed vehicles may serve (pinned compatibility).

force_deny_sites.description: Stop ids this vehicle type must never serve.

OptimizeVehicle.description:
A vehicle (type): solver vehicle constraints; `available_count` clones this
type. The three reference lists take **stop/depot ids** (as passed in this
request) and mirror task.fbs `Vehicle.force_allow_sites` /
`force_deny_sites` / `reload_depots`.

fixed.description: Cost per use of the vehicle; charged only when it drives a route.

distance.description: Cost per km (or per mile when the plan's display unit is miles).

duration.description: Cost per hour of route time.

stop.description:
Cost per stop served (each order visit; a transfer pair counts its
pickup and delivery separately). Depot and reload visits are free.
No unit conversion: charged per visit in your cost units.

overtime.description:
Surcharge per hour of overtime, paired with the vehicle's
`max_overtime_s` cap. When overtime is allowed and this is unset, it
defaults to the `duration` rate (or a nominal 1/hour if that is 0)
so allowed overtime is never free; an explicit 0 makes it free.

ride_overtime.description:
Cost per hour of a linked (pickup & delivery) order's ride time
inside its overtime band (`max_ride_overtime_s`, past
`max_time_in_vehicle_s`). Unset/0 => that band is free.

load_distance.description:
Cost per unit of load carried per km (or per mile when the plan's
display unit is miles): every leg charges the load on board times
the leg's length, so heavier cargo is priced onto shorter paths
and dropped early. Models load-dependent fuel/energy burn and
refrigerated (cold chain) running cost. Counts toward the fleet's
"priced" signal like `distance`/`duration`. Unset/0 => carriage
is free.

solver.VehicleCost.description:
Per-vehicle cost rates. An omitted field means 0. Exception: when NO
vehicle in the fleet has a nonzero `distance`, `duration` or
`load_distance` rate, the
optimizer falls back to minimizing plain travel distance (so an
all-blank fleet still gets sensible routes); setting every cost to an
explicit 0 triggers the same fallback plus a warning. An explicit 0 is
meaningful in a mixed fleet (e.g. a bike with free mileage next to a
priced van).

paidFeatures.description: Present only when the plan uses paid features outside this account.

warnings.description:
Non-blocking notes about how the request was interpreted (e.g. an
all-zero cost model replaced by the plain-distance default). Omitted
when there is nothing to say.

OptimizeStarted.description: Result of `routing24_optimize`: the solve is running, poll for progress.

locked.description:
Paid capabilities the plan uses that this account's plan does not
include, as `Feature` member names (e.g. `"Skills"`, `"DriverBreaks"`).

stripped.description:
The subset DROPPED from this solve because the free allowance for paid
features is spent. Empty while the allowance lasts. A non-empty list
means the routes ignore those constraints — say so when reporting the
plan, and name the upgrade as the way to get them back.

freeRunsLeft.description: Free solves left that may use locked features (0 once spent).

PaidFeatureReport.description:
What `routing24_optimize` did with the paid features the plan uses. Absent
when the plan uses none, or when every one of them is included in the user's
subscription — the common case, and nothing to report.

addresses.description: Address strings to geocode (free-form, as a user would type them).

input.description: The address string as passed in.

problemsCount.description: Total constraint-problem markers across all routes (0 = feasible).

driftFromOptimized.description: Drift vs the last full optimization (absent while a solve runs).

optimizedAt.description: When the baseline solve completed (ms since epoch).

distancePct.description: Travel-distance change vs the baseline, percent (+ = longer).

durationPct.description: Total-duration change vs the baseline, percent (+ = slower).

cost.description:
ECONOMIC cost change, money (+ = more expensive). Coverage drift is
`unassigned` (a count) — the two are never merged into one number.
Absent when the baseline carried no cost.

costPct.description: Cost change vs the baseline, percent (+ = more expensive).

problems.description: New problem markers vs the baseline (+ = worse).

unassigned.description: Newly unassigned stops vs the baseline (+ = worse).

severity.description:
Fixed-threshold verdict: any new problem/unassigned ⇒ at least
`degraded`; cost, distance or duration > +5% ⇒ `degraded`, > +15% ⇒
`severe`; everything ≤ baseline with a ≥1% gain ⇒ `improved`; else
`neutral`.

summary.description: One ready-to-quote sentence, lexicographic: coverage first, then money.

OptimizedDrift.description:
How far the CURRENT plan has drifted from the last full optimization —
covering every change since that solve, the user's manual edits included.
Recompute-free: the baseline is frozen at solve completion; only a new
`routing24_optimize` (or the user's OPTIMIZE button) resets it. Absent when
the plan predates the baseline feature or was never solved.

REPORTING OBLIGATION: when `severity` is `degraded` or `severe`, tell the
user (quote `summary`) and offer to fix it — `routing24_optimize_route` for
a single rough route, or a fresh solve.

available.description: `false` when the loaded plan carries no optimized solution yet.

planUrl.description: Absolute URL of the plan's optimize page.

feasible.description: True when every constraint is satisfied.

complete.description: True when the solve ran to completion (not cancelled part-way).

stopCount.description: Number of site stops served across all routes.

unassignedCount.description: Number of site stops that could not be served.

distance.description: Total travel distance across all routes, in `distanceUnit`.

durationHours.description: Total duration across all routes, hours.

unassigned.description: Ids of the sites left unassigned, if any.

cost.description: Economic cost (money). Coverage is `unassignedCount`, never a cost.

objective.description: Solver comparison scalar — see {@link SolverObjective}; never money.

problemsCount.description: Total constraint-problem markers across all routes (0 = feasible).

routes.description: One entry per route slot (empty slots included), in slot order.

revision.description: Session revision the routes reflect; bumps on every committed edit.

undoDepth.description: Committed edits that `routing24_undo` can walk back.

userAssigned.description: Site ids currently marked user-assigned (manually placed).

userUnassigned.description: Unassigned site ids that were removed by the user/agent (not the solver).

alternativesNotChosen.description: Group-alternative sites not chosen (their sibling serves the group).

editedAt.description: Last manual-edit timestamp (ms since epoch); absent = never edited.

diagnosticsStale.description:
True when `unassignedDiagnostics` predates the latest edits — pass
`refresh_diagnostics: true` to recompute before reading it.

unassignedDiagnostics.description: Why sites are unassigned, in prose (capped; see `truncated`/`omitted`).

insertionQuotes.description:
Ready-to-serve quotes for the unassigned orders (one per quotable
site; none when nothing fits). Refreshed with the diagnostics — pass
`refresh_diagnostics: true` when `diagnosticsStale`.

driftFromOptimized.description:
Drift vs the last full optimization (user's manual edits included) —
when `severity` is `degraded`/`severe`, tell the user and offer a fix.

PlanSolution.description:
The full optimized solution for the currently-loaded plan — whether it was
just optimized in this tab or opened via its URL. This is the structured data
behind {@link OptimizeStatus}: the same rollups plus every route's ordered
stops. `available` is `false` (and the detail fields are omitted) when the
loaded plan has no solution yet.

total.description:
Full economic cost: fixed + distance + duration (incl. overtime) + stop
+ ride overtime + load-distance.

overtime.description: Overtime premium — a breakdown line already inside `total`.

stop.description: Per-stop cost addend inside `total` (absent when no vehicle prices stops).

rideOvertime.description:
Cost of the linked orders' ride time inside their overtime band, at the
serving vehicle's `cost.ride_overtime` — an addend inside `vehicle`
(absent when no route ran into a priced band).

loadDistance.description:
Carriage cost: load on board times leg length, summed over legs, at
each serving vehicle's `cost.load_distance` — an addend inside
`vehicle` (absent when no vehicle prices load-distance).

SolutionCost.description:
ECONOMIC cost of the solution, in the task's money units (the unit costs
configured on the vehicles). Report money to the user from here. It does
NOT include unassigned-order penalties — coverage is a count
(`unassignedCount`), not a cost. Absent on pre-feature solutions.

unassignedPenalty.description: Σ synthetic penalties of unassigned orders (incl. alternatives not chosen).

SolverObjective.description:
The scalar the solver minimizes — SOLVER UNITS, NOT MONEY, never quote it
to the user. Each unassigned order carries a synthetic penalty priced
above any possible serving cost, so fewer-unassigned always outranks
cheaper-routes. Use it ONLY to compare two states of the same plan:
lower `objective.total` = better plan. Equivalent hand rule: fewer
unassigned wins; ties break on lower `cost.total`.

slot.description:
0-based route slot — the address every `routing24_edit` op (`to_route`,
`route`, `target`, `sources`) and `routing24_optimize_route` use. Slots
compact after `remove_routes`; re-read them from the returned state.

index.description: 1-based route number, matching the on-screen order (slot + 1).

vehicleId.description: Id of the vehicle serving this route.

siteCount.description: Count of site stops served (the depot start/end are excluded).

distance.description: Total travel distance of the route, in `distanceUnit`.

durationHours.description: Total route duration (travel + service + wait), hours.

startTimeS.description:
When the route starts (depot departure, or arrival at the first
order on an open-start route), seconds since midnight.

endTimeS.description:
When the route ends (depot return, or service completion at the last
order on an open-ended route), seconds since midnight.

feasible.description: True when every constraint on this route is satisfied.

cost.description: Economic cost of this route (absent on pre-feature solutions).

stops.description:
Stops in visit order; bounded by depot stops unless the vehicle's
start/finish depot is empty (open-ended).

PlanSolutionRoute.description:
One route slot: an ordered stop sequence, bounded by depot stops when the
vehicle has a start/finish depot (open-ended ends start/finish at an order
instead). Empty slots (a vehicle with no stops, e.g. just created by
`create_route`) are included with `siteCount: 0` so `slot` stays a
complete, editable address space.

amount.description: How far over the constraint (see {@link PlanProblemType} for units).

PlanProblemType.description:
Constraint kinds a problem can report (common.fbs `ConstraintType`).
`amount` units: seconds for the time kinds, load units for `capacity`,
distance for `max_distance`.

total.description:
Full economic cost of the route: fixed + distance + duration (incl.
overtime) + stop + ride overtime + load-distance.

stop.description: Per-stop cost addend inside `total` (absent when the vehicle has no stop cost).

rideOvertime.description:
Cost of this route's linked orders' ride time inside their overtime
band, at the vehicle's `cost.ride_overtime` — an addend inside `vehicle`
(absent when the route ran into no priced band).

loadDistance.description:
This route's carriage cost: load on board times leg length, summed
over legs, at the vehicle's `cost.load_distance` — an addend inside
`vehicle` (absent when the vehicle prices no load-distance).

RouteCost.description:
One route's ECONOMIC cost, in the task's money units. Same shape rules as
{@link SolutionCost}.

seq.description: 0-based position within the route (0 = the starting depot).

type.description:
The depot, a delivery/pickup site, or a scheduled driver break. A
`break` stop is a solver-planned pause taken AT the previous stop's
location: it has no `id`/`address`, `serviceDurationS` is the pause
length, and its travel-leg fields are 0.

id.description: The site/depot id (the id you passed to optimize, or an auto-assigned one).

arrivalTimeS.description: Arrival time, seconds since midnight (physical driver timeline).

departureTimeS.description: End of service (arrival + wait + service), seconds since midnight.

serviceDurationS.description: Time spent servicing this stop, seconds.

waitDurationS.description: Wait before the stop's time window opens, seconds (0/absent = none).

legDistance.description: Distance of the travel leg arriving at this stop, in `distanceUnit`.

legDurationS.description: Duration of the travel leg arriving at this stop, seconds.

pickedUpLoad.description: Load picked up at this stop.

problems.description: Constraint problems materializing at this stop (absent = none).

marginalCost.description:
Removal saving — how much cheaper (money) / shorter (seconds) this
route gets without this stop, same vehicle kept. An estimate for the
CURRENT stop order: savings are NOT additive across stops and change
after any edit or re-optimize. Absent on depots and pre-feature plans.

summary.description: One-paragraph overview of the unassigned situation.

truncated.description: True when the per-site list was capped (see `omitted`).

category.description: Coarse cause (e.g. hard incompatibility vs fleet contention).

blockers.description: Site ids standing in the way (competition for the same capacity).

levers.description: Constraint changes that would let this site be served.

omitted.description: Rollup of the sites the cap left out.

UnassignedDiagnosticsReport.description:
Prose explanation of why sites are unassigned (common.fbs
`UnassignedDiagnosticsLlm` — the agent-facing projection, capped in size).

deliveryAfter.description:
Pair quote (site = the pickup): where the DELIVERY step is quoted, after
the pickup (precedence-aware). Absent for a single order.

InsertionQuote.description:
The cheapest FEASIBLE way to serve one unassigned order in the current
routes — REAL units (money / seconds), safe to quote to the user. Directly
replayable as a `move_sites` edit: use `before`/`after` as the anchor (or
`to_route: routeSlot` with `placement: "best"` when both are absent).
`routeSlot` absent = a spare `vehicleId` vehicle serves it on a fresh
single-visit route, its fixed cost included (an existing route's fixed
cost is sunk and excluded). Estimates for the CURRENT arrangement only:
quotes are NOT additive across orders and go stale with any edit or
re-optimize (`diagnosticsStale`).

refresh_diagnostics.description:
Recompute the unassigned-site diagnostics before returning them (runs an
engine pass; only needed when `diagnosticsStale` was true).

EditInput.description:
Input for `routing24_edit` (edits.fbs `EditBatch`): an ordered batch applied
ALL-OR-NOTHING — the first rejected op rolls the whole batch back. Ops see the
effects of earlier ops in the same batch (e.g. `create_route` then
`move_sites` onto the new slot). Revision guarding is handled internally.

EditOp.description: One edit operation (edits.fbs `Edit` union; discriminated on `op`).

before.description: Anchor site id: insert the block immediately before it.

after.description: Anchor site id: insert the block immediately after it.

placement.description: With `to_route`: `append` to the end, or `best` = cheapest insertion.

user_assigned.description: Mark the sites user-assigned (badge + problem report). Default true.

EditMoveSites.description:
Move `sites` as ONE ordered block (edits.fbs `MoveSites`). Destination is
exactly one of: `before`/`after` (anchor site id, must be planned and not in
`sites`), or `to_route` (+ `placement`). Also the way to plan an unassigned
site: move it from nowhere onto a route.

vehicle.description: Vehicle id; rejects `vehicle_overused` when its count is exhausted.

EditSetRouteVehicle.description: Rebind a route slot to another fleet vehicle (edits.fbs `SetRouteVehicle`).

user_unassigned.description:
Stamp the "removed by you" marker (default true). Pass false to unassign
without claiming the removal, keeping the site's original unassigned reason.

EditUnassignSites.description: Remove sites from their routes into the unassigned list (edits.fbs `UnassignSites`).

EditMarkUserAssigned.description: Mark already-planned sites user-assigned (badge only; edits.fbs `MarkUserAssigned`).

EditClearUserAssigned.description: Drop the user-assigned mark + report ("Dismiss"; edits.fbs `ClearUserAssigned`).

EditCreateRoute.description: Append an empty route slot for `vehicle` (edits.fbs `CreateRoute`).

EditRemoveRoutes.description:
Delete EMPTY route slots (edits.fbs `RemoveRoutes`; `route_not_empty`
otherwise — `unassign_sites` or move the stops first). Remaining slots compact:
put this op last in the batch and re-read slots from the result.

after.description: Site id that becomes the last stop of the head route.

EditSplitRoute.description:
Split a route in two after site `after` (edits.fbs `SplitRoute`). The head
keeps the slot + vehicle; the tail becomes a new appended slot served by
`vehicle` (defaults to the same vehicle type).

EditMergeRoutes.description: Append `sources` routes' stops onto `target`, leaving the sources empty (edits.fbs `MergeRoutes`).

applied.description: True when the whole batch committed; false = nothing was applied.

rejection.description: Why the batch rolled back (all-or-nothing), when the engine rejected it.

state.description: Current state — post-apply, or unchanged when the batch was rejected.

userAssignedReports.description: Problem reports for all currently user-assigned sites (when `applied`).

reason.description: Human-readable rejection detail, when the engine supplies one.

EditOpStatus.description: The rejected op of a failed batch (edits.fbs `EditStatus`).

EditRejectionCode.description:
Why an edit batch was rejected (edits.fbs `EditRejection`, minus `none`).
Notable: `stale_revision` = the plan changed under you — re-read
`routing24_solution` and rebuild the batch; `optimize_in_progress` = wait for
the running optimization; slot codes mean your `slot` numbers are outdated.

problemsCount.description: Total constraint-problem markers across all routes (0 = feasible).

unassigned.description: Ids of the sites currently unassigned.

cost.description: Economic cost (money). Coverage is `unassignedCount`, never a cost.

objective.description: Solver comparison scalar — see {@link SolverObjective}; never money.

routes.description: Every route slot, fresh — supersedes slots from before the mutation.

driftFromOptimized.description: Drift vs the last full optimization — report `degraded`/`severe`.

SessionState.description: Post-mutation session snapshot shared by the editing tools' results.

slot.description: 0-based route slot (fresh — valid for the next edit batch).

stops.description: Ordered site ids (depots excluded); empty = empty slot.

cost.description: Economic cost of this route (absent on pre-feature solutions).

RouteSummary.description: One route slot's summary in a {@link SessionState} (post-edit snapshot).

route.description: Route slot the site sits on.

UserAssignedProblemReport.description:
The problem report behind a user-assigned site's badge (edits.fbs
`UserAssignedReport`): what placing it costs, split into problems the site
would have anywhere (`intrinsic`) vs ones this placement introduced.

route.description: Route slot to optimize (see `PlanSolutionRoute.slot`); needs ≥2 stops.

time_limit_s.description: Wall budget in seconds; omit to auto-scale with route size (1.5–5s).

OptimizeRouteInput.description: Input for `routing24_optimize_route`: re-sequence ONE route's stops.

started.description: False when the run could not start (see `errorCode`/`error`).
